melissar_estate.name: The Melissar estate

canon_ref.note: Where the northern nobles meet. The text gives no city or road. No map.

melissar_estate.summary: The manor of House Melissar in the north, where the great houses gather about the King of Destruction.

germina.name: Germina

canon_ref.note: Ruled by the Quarass. Named in the chandrar summary already. 4.06KM reports Flos broke it and killed the Quarass.

germina.summary: A nation of Chandrar ruled by the Quarass, one of the six that went to war against Reim.

hellios.name: Hellios

canon_ref.note: Queen Calliope rules; Prince Siyal leads its army.

hellios.summary: A nation of Chandrar whose king Flos killed long ago. It leads the war against Reim.

house_of_minos.name: The House of Minos

canon_ref.note: Home of the Minotaurs. The text calls its ruler both 'King' and 'she'; left unsettled.

house_of_minos.summary: The Minotaurs' nation, whose envoy offers the northern nobles an army against Flos.

manimar.name: Manimar

canon_ref.note: History only (4.01K-4.02K). On Crusland land near Reim.

manimar.summary: A village on Venith Crusland's land that swears to Flos again.

rast.name: Rast

canon_ref.note: History only (4.03K). Its gates open to Flos; the Mayor is killed by a mob.

rast.summary: A starving city near Reim that opens its gates to the King of Destruction.
